d95.7a.S2.page.duane.text: Duane, the Tattler. Weekends in the lot at Moose River North: a green pickup, a lawn chair, a plaster cast.

d95.7a.S2.page.site.text: The west site on Big Moose, under the ridge. Two stars, a bad landing. Nobody wants it.

d95.7a.S2.page.walt.text: Walt slept out there in his canoe, tied to a snag off the point.

d95.7a.S2.page.night.text: Two in the morning on Big Moose. Steps on the ridge, a knock on wood, twice. Then nothing for a minute.

d95.7a.S2.page.tracks.text: In the morning, up on the ridge: a moose and a calf, and the serviceberry stripped.

d95.7a.S2.page.frame.text: One picture from 2:04. Two birches, and something between them. Nothing there by day.

d95.7a.S2.end.solved.text: A moose in the deadfall and a bear in the berries. Duane ran it anyway.

d95.7a.S2.end.kept.text: Kept the picture. Haven't shown anybody.

d95.7a.S2.wake.text: Two in the morning. You come awake. Something heavy on the ridge behind the tent.

d95.7a.S2.charge.text: The cow lays her ears back, stamps, and comes three strides at you. Then she's gone, crashing.

d95.7a.S2.eyes.text: Two eyes in the lamp, green-gold, two metres up. Then a long face. Then they go.

d95.7a.S2.cast.text: Bear. Hind foot over the front.

d95.7a.S3.page.elaine.text: Elaine Sundquist keeps the sky book at Slim. Everything's something, she says.

d95.7a.S3.page.aurora.text: Northern lights over Fourtown, low in the north. In the book.

d95.7a.S3.page.train.text: A string of lights climbing out of the west, one after another. Satellites. In the book.

d95.7a.S3.page.lantern.text: A light floating at the north end in the fog. Somebody's lantern. In the book.

d95.7a.S3.page.foxfire.text: Foxfire off the north shore, a green chunk of birch. Elaine turned the shop lights off for it.

d95.7a.S3.page.square.text: Walt wrote in her book in 2012. 'Kept the red on.' She wrote 'boat?' beside it.

d95.7a.S3.page.tin.text: Under the loose stone at the long rock: a tobacco tin. Red glass in oilcloth, three matches.

d95.7a.S3.page.one.text: A light over the north bay. Low, steady. It drifted against the wind and went out when I showed white.

d95.7a.S3.end.text: Elaine wrote a question mark in red. Her first.

d95.7a.S4.page.kari.text: Kari Vang counts wolves on Agnes. Three places, three lines, they cross where the wolves are.

d95.7a.S4.page.tracks.text: Kari at the landing: front foot, toes tight, like it's going somewhere. A dog's go everywhere.

d95.7a.S4.page.st1.text: Nina Moose, the north end, three in the morning. They answered.

d95.7a.S4.page.st3.text: Walt's site on Agnes, the sand landing. They answered.

d95.7a.S4.page.ring.text: The three lines cross west of Agnes, in the primitive area.

d95.7a.S4.page.kill.text: Ravens over a kill. A deer, mostly hair and bones.

d95.7a.S4.page.count.text: The meadow from the ridge at dusk. Pups at the edge of the alders.

d95.7a.S4.page.told.text: I told someone where the meadow is.

d95.7a.S4.pay.station.text: $15 from Kari, a night at a station.

d95.7a.S4.lyle2.text: Me again. Sixty-five for a ring on my map. Last time I'll ask.

d95.7a.S4.give.text: Show him the ring on the map.

d95.7a.S4.howl.hint.text: Wait for an answer. Face it, then {E} Mark.
